source.axes: muzzle / head at -X, +Y up, the weapon's right side (the master's visible side) facing -Z

weld.rule: exact-attribute weld (bitwise-equal position / normal / uv), degenerate triangles and unreferenced vertices dropped: lossless

processing.simplify: none: Meshy's triangle count is kept (held-weapon first-person density)
processing.rotation: rotateY(-90deg): (x, y, z) -> (-z, y, x); raw -X (muzzle / head) -> game -Z, raw -Z (the master's visible = the weapon's RIGHT side) -> game +X
processing.lengthRule: uniform scale so the overall Z extent (muzzle / head to butt / pommel) = the plan's real length
processing.origin: the bounding box (all parts) centred on the origin

ops.why: lead decision (lane AG accept of R007): the box magazine (26 mm, base pad 32 mm) is fused to the receiver; cut exactly just below the magazine-well lip (y -0.002; the receiver's lower edge dips to -0.0015) between the trigger guard (z > 0.057) and the receiver front (z < -0.045), inside x +-0.0175
ops.name: Magazine

clip.rule: the body mesh clipped to the box min [-0.0175,-1,-0.045] max [0.0175,-0.002,0.057] (m; 6 finite faces): triangles crossing a face are split exactly along it (interpolated position / normal / UV)

pivot.rule: the top centre of the part (x / z centre, max y): the magazine well

Grip.rule: x = the middle of a ray along X at y / z [-0.05,0.18] (the mid-plane there)

Muzzle.rule: the front face: z = the minimum z; x / y = the centre of the vertices within 0.004 m of it

Sight.rule: x = the middle of a ray along X at y / z (the outermost surfaces: the local mid-plane)

Eject.rule: x = the right-hand receiver surface (the right-most hit of a ray along X at y / z [0.04,0], beside the port)

processing.markerNotes: Sight: the eye line through the rear diopter aperture (open from 0.107 up on the centre line) at the front post tip (0.105)
